briefing: - 10个高危均未见在野利用、勒索或POC标记
- 批量公告含6个CVSS≥9.3，需统一排查

items.title: WebSphere CSP配置不当绕过
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可利用不当CSP配置绕过安全限制，可能导致敏感信息泄露或脚本执行
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本；无法升级时收紧CSP策略
items.repro_note: 需确认目标启用受影响CSP配置，构造绕过策略访问受限资源
items.impact_scope: 企业中间件，通常内网部署
items.description: IBM WebSphere Extreme Scale 8.6.1.0 through 8.6.2.2 could allow a remote attacker to bypass security restrictions due to improper Content Security Policy configuration.

items.title: OpenEMR药品库存SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 低权限认证用户向Fee Sheet的warehouse参数注入SQL，可盲注窃取患者数据和密码哈希
items.action_zh: 升级至OpenEMR 8.3.0或更高版本，限制低权限账号
items.repro_note: 低权限登录，向Fee Sheet的warehouse参数注入ORDER BY
items.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the Fee Sheet drug-inventory lookup (DrugSalesService::sellDrug) that interpolates the prod[N][warehouse] POST field into an ORDER BY clause. Low-privileged authenticated users can submit Fee Sheet product lines with constant subqueries to run a time-based blind oracle, extracting patient data and users_secure bcrypt hashes.

items.title: OpenEMR服务令牌重放与PIN爆破
items.summary_zh: 持有泄露service_auth令牌者可重放并爆破PIN，接管患者门户会话并泄露PHI
items.action_zh: 升级至OpenEMR 8.4.0；轮换service_auth令牌并启用限速
items.repro_note: 需持有已泄露service_auth令牌，重放并暴力尝试login_pin
items.impact_scope: 医疗门户，暴露患者隐私数据
items.description: OpenEMR from 7.0.1 before 8.4.0 contains a flaw in src/Common/Auth/OneTimeAuth.php that ignores the enforce_onetime_use and max_access_count flags, never revokes consumed service_auth tokens, and checks login_pin without rate limiting or strict comparison. Attackers holding a captured token can replay it or brute-force the PIN to open patient-portal sessions exposing PHI.

items.title: Melapress角色编辑器权限提升
items.summary_zh: 低权限用户可借错误权限分配提升为管理员，进而完全控制WordPress站点
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级Melapress Role Editor至1.3.1+；无法升级则停用插件
items.description: Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in Melapress Melapress Role Editor melapress-role-editor allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects Melapress Role Editor: from n/a through 1.3.0.

items.title: SunEditor文档头存储型XSS
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可向文档标题存入实体编码HTML，编辑器初始化时执行脚本并窃取会话
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级SunEditor至3.4.0；过滤h1-h6标题中的HTML实体
items.repro_note: 在document:header模式向h1-h6标题写入实体编码HTML
items.impact_scope: 富文本编辑器组件，影响Web前端
items.description: SunEditor before 3.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the DocumentType constructor that injects header textContent into innerHTML without HTML escaping. Attackers can store entity-encoded HTML in h1-h6 headers that executes JavaScript when editors using document:header mode initialize, enabling session cookie theft.

items.title: SunEditor链接清洗绕过存储XSS
items.summary_zh: 攻击者存入javascript:链接绕过URL校验，受害者点击后执行脚本窃取Cookie
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级至SunEditor 3.4.0；修复前禁用链接清洗或严格校验href
items.repro_note: 在可编辑链接中写入javascript:，诱导点击触发XSS
items.impact_scope: 富文本编辑器组件，影响Web前端
items.description: SunEditor before 3.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because the html.clean() sanitizer's _normalizeURL() function decodes named entities like : to an empty string. Attackers can inject href values such as javascript: that pass the _isSafeURL() check but are decoded by browsers, executing JavaScript when victims click stored links.

items.title: Process Mining访问控制缺失
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可利用错误访问控制读取敏感信息，造成业务数据泄露
items.action_zh: 升级至IBM修复版本；临时限制Process Mining网络访问
items.repro_note: 访问受影响接口，利用缺失的权限校验读取敏感数据
items.impact_scope: ERP分析系统，内网业务数据
items.description: IBM Process Mining 2.0.0 through 2.2.1 could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information due to improper access control.

items.title: IBM Optim路径遍历文件读取
items.title_zh: IBM Optim路径遍历文件读取
items.summary_zh: 远程认证攻击者通过路径遍历读取任意文件，可能泄露配置与敏感数据
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级至IBM修复版本；限制认证账号文件访问权限
items.repro_note: 认证后向文件相关接口传入../路径，读取任意文件
items.impact_scope: 企业数据管理平台，内网部署
items.description: IBM Optim 1.0.0, 1.1.0, and 1.2.0 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to path traversal.

items.title: Frontend Admin权限分配错误提权
items.title_zh: Frontend Admin权限分配错误提权
items.summary_zh: 低权限用户可利用错误权限分配提升权限，进而控制WordPress站点
items.action_zh: 升级Frontend Admin至3.30.2+；无法升级则停用插件
items.description: Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in DynamiApps Frontend Admin by DynamiApps acf-frontend-form-element allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects Frontend Admin by DynamiApps: from n/a through 3.30.1.

items.title: OpenEMR传真模块路径遍历RCE
items.summary_zh: 认证攻击者通过file_path遍历读写任意文件，可窃取凭据并写入WebShell执行代码
items.action_zh: 升级至OpenEMR 8.3.0；限制传真模块账号与文件权限
items.impact_scope: 医疗系统传真模块，可写Web目录
items.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the RingCentral RCFaxClient disposeDocument() method of oe-module-faxsms that allows authenticated attackers to read and write arbitrary files via the file_path parameter. Attackers can use action=download to read credentials and source code, or action=setup with base64 content to write web-executable files for code execution.
